name: Signal for Pickup
summary: Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge has a Standard Issue Flare Gun for you. Speak with him to get it.

sections.title: A Signal in Ironforge
sections.body: In Ironforge, Xiggs Fuselighter is the one to speak with. He has a Standard Issue Flare Gun for you, and the next step depends on getting it from him.

faq.answer: Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge has the Standard Issue Flare Gun.

faq.q: What do I need to get from Xiggs?
faq.answer: You need to get a Standard Issue Flare Gun from Xiggs Fuselighter.

attribution: In-game quest text: Signal for Pickup
